summary: Frontend-only prototype (TraceTax AI) tested end-to-end via Playwright. All 25 review items pass: 12 returns render, search + empty state + reset work, all 5 filter tabs present with counts, Jordan Lee return opens at /returns/ret-2025-001, header (Jordan Lee, CPA Review, Maya Chen, Apr 15 2026, 1040) shows correctly, all section-nav testids (overview, income, wages, interest, self-employment, adjustments, deductions, credits, payments, filing-summary, documents, activity) present, wages field row shows 84,520 / 84,250 / 96% / Needs review, Accept AI flow updates field to Verified with value 84,250 and toast, Keep Current dialog enforces required reason (blocked without input, closes after reason filled), Manual override dialog works with new-value + reason + confirm, evidence panel has all 4 tabs, source doc preview + amber highlight visible for W-2, request-document-btn visible on Charitable (Missing source) row & fires toast, locked-jump links (2) present on Total itemized deductions row, resolve-conflict buttons (2) visible on Employer name conflict row & clicking fires 'Conflict resolved' toast, Activity page loads with CPA/AI badges, Documents page shows 7 documents with preview update, top nav links (Review Queue/Documents/Activity) work, zero console errors on any page. Design is clean CPA-professional (dark navy, restrained status colors).
critical_code_review_comments: Conditional testids (request-document-btn, locked-jump-*, resolve-conflict-*, manual-correction-btn-*) render only when the specific field row with the matching status is selected in the workspace. This is correct behavior but worth documenting for QA — testers must click the specific field row first before asserting these selectors.

Activity page did not contain the literal string 'Client' in initial body scan; badges use CPA/AI actor labels visibly but ensure Client-actor events are also displayed if data includes them (minor, not a bug — check /app/frontend/src/data/activity.js coverage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prototype is frontend-only, no backend. State resets on refresh (expected). All 25 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright with data-testid selectors. Conditional testids in evidence panel/locked/conflict rows require selecting the matching field row first.
